name: oblivion-science-signal
title: Oblivion Signal — Science Telemetry
author: joaomcarlos
description: Sends one JSON datagram per second over UDP to the Oblivion Signal desktop rail, which ACKs each sample back — while ACKs arrive the mod does no file IO. Without --enable-lua-udp it falls back to appending script-output/oblivion-science.jsonl. Telemetry: current research, its progress, and science packs consumed per minute.
